customManagers.description: OPENWRT_TAG in ci/*.env and the commit it resolves to (OPENWRT_COMMIT, on the next line), from OpenWrt's release tags

Tools downloaded by the workflows: a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment above a line holding version=<tag> sum=<sha256>; github-release-attachments takes the new sum from the release's checksums file

packageRules.description: An OpenWrt series jump (major/minor) can need DTS or seed changes: it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard
Pin container base images by digest: a floating tag would change the toolchain under a reproducible build
A base-image major bump changes the whole toolchain: approval only
Everything but OpenWrt itself is build tooling, never urgent: one grouped PR on the 1st of each month
